thesis: IDXX is a high-quality compounder (operating margin 32.5%, ROE 68.9%) that re-rated on the 11/02 earnings gap and has held a tight 672-715 range above all major averages, in a leading defensive sector, which fits the post-earnings consolidation pattern noted in lessons. The edge exists only on a pullback: R/R is 1.75 from the 702 zone midpoint but about 1.22 at the 709.46 last close, below the 1.5 rule, while the regime is risk-off (confidence 0.9), valuation is rich, the mean analyst target of 717.17 sits at spot, and the 757 target is a measured move rather than a confirmed level. Hold now; re-assess for Overweight if price trades into roughly 696-705, where R/R at the fill clears 1.5.
invalidation: A daily close below 672.7 (post-earnings consolidation floor), or a failed breakout that closes back under 690 on rising volume after a push above 715.
key_risks: Risk-off regime with QQQ below its 50/200-day averages and VIX at the 0.90 1y percentile argues for reduced long exposure
Extended after a +26.4% 21-day run with no earnings catalyst before 2027-02-01 and consensus target about 1% above spot
Rich valuation (trailing P/E 47.8, forward P/E 42.0) with revenue growth slowing from about 14.3% to about 9.9% YoY
Cause of the gap is inferred, not sourced; recent support is passive ETF flow that can fade
Correlated healthcare exposure across the book; thin half-day liquidity (13:00 ET close)
